newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Arab-Malaysian Corp plans cash call.
newsitem.headline: Arab-Malaysian Corp plans cash call.

text.p: Arab-Malaysian Corporation Bhd (Amcorp), the holding company for one of Malaysia's biggest finance groups, plans a capital raising exercise soon, chairman Azman Hashim said.
He told Reuters in an interview on Thursday that Amcorp's issue was aimed at increasing shareholders' funds and followed similar fund-raising by other companies in the group.
"There will be soon an announcement to raise capital by Amcorp. That is the natural extension of the (group's fund-raising) exercise," he said.
He declined to give details of the planned issues.
He said AMMB Holdings Bhd had recently proposed two rights issues of stocks and bonds to raise up to 890 million ringgit.
In its proposal for the two issues, Amcorp said the funds would be used for the expansion of its units, Arab-Malaysian Bank and the Arab-Malaysian Finance Bhd.
Analysts said the Amcorp issue would be big as it would have to subscribe to any planned rights portion in its 44.6 percent-owned AMMB Holdings Bhd and also fund its expansion.
